scientific_limitations: Only finite labelled clique coronas with n>=2 and synchronous unweighted strict open-neighbor binary majority, preserving a bit upon ties. Counts initially periodic configurations, not the transient basin populations; no assertion for other graph families or tie conventions.
title: Parity bifurcation of majority two-cycles on clique coronas \(K_n\odot K_1\)
